cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Shield Platform Encryption Architecture Decisions'. Subtitle in white: 'Field semantics, search, keys, integrations, reporting, and scale tradeoffs'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Business Data Classification' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'PII Fields', 'Regulated Identifiers', 'Operational Search Keys' as bright white pill badges with micro lock icons. MID LAYER 'Encryption Design' vivid purple border — modules 'Probabilistic Encryption', 'Deterministic Encryption', 'Tenant Secret Lifecycle' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Runtime Impact' vivid teal/green border — modules 'SOQL Filters', 'Reports & Search', 'API Integrations' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Irreversible Decisions' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'Agentforce 2.0 grounding controls' and 'Data 360 federation boundaries'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Architecture Review' → 'Classify Fields' → 'Choose Mode' → 'Design Search' → 'Plan Key Operations' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Shield Encryption Search Tradeoff'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Shield Encryption Search Tradeoff'. Subtitle 'Do not make encrypted PII carry every query pattern'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Probabilistic protects patterns with lock icon', 'Deterministic enables equality with equals icon', 'HMAC search key isolates lookup with key icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD LABEL: Query encrypted PII directly' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD LABEL: Query surrogate search key' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE National_ID__c = :rawNationalId; right column green border '// GOOD' code: SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE National_ID_Search_Key__c = :hmacKey WITH USER_MODE;. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Classify field sensitivity', 'Map query behavior', 'Backfill before cutover'. Footer bar: 'Encryption mode is an access-pattern decision, not a checkbox'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Shield Key Rotation Runbook'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Shield Key Rotation Runbook'. Subtitle 'Encryption keys require ownership, rehearsal, and rollback criteria'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Owner with shield icon', 'Rotation window with clock icon', 'Audit evidence with document icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD LABEL: Undocumented key lifecycle' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD LABEL: Versioned search-key rotation' with green SUCCESS pill. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Dual-read during rotation', 'Backfill v2 search keys', 'Retire v1 after audit'. Footer bar: 'Key rotation is an operating model, not a deployment task'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.
